//! Run this helper against the v3 source at c296625 (before applying v4).
//! See fixtures/README.md. It deliberately refuses to overwrite a fixture.
mod support;

use strata_store::{MoveBaseline, NewProposal, ReplayPlan};
use strata_types::{CommitOid, DepsSetId};
use support::world::*;

#[test]
#[ignore = "fixture generator: run only against the pinned v3 source"]
fn generate_v3_fixture() {
    let env = support::env();
    let s = env.open();
    world(&env, &s);
    let head = CommitOid::try_from("2".repeat(40)).unwrap();
    s.record_proposal(&NewProposal {
        repo: repo(), origin: None, from: gen1().deps,
        from_inputs: "a".repeat(64), to: DepsSetId::try_from("b".repeat(64)).unwrap(),
        to_inputs: "b".repeat(64), tree: Some(gen1().tree), head: Some(head.clone()),
    }, None, t(20)).unwrap();
    s.plan_replay(&repo(), &[ReplayPlan { session: sid(), planned_head: head.to_string(), planned_tree: gen1().tree.to_string() }], t(21)).unwrap();
    s.settle_planned(&sid(), &repo(), head.as_str(), true, t(22)).unwrap();
    s.begin_move_with(&sid(), &repo(), &gen1(), &head, &env.root.join("sessions").join(sid().as_str()).join(".m2"), t(23),
        Some(&MoveBaseline { m0_ns: 1, t0_ns: 2, root_names: vec!["a".into()], entries: 1 })).unwrap();
    s.close().unwrap();
    let bytes = std::fs::read(env.db()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(u32::from_be_bytes(bytes[60..64].try_into().unwrap()), 3);
    let out = std::path::Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("tests/fixtures/store-v3.db");
    use std::io::Write;
    std::fs::OpenOptions::new().write(true).create_new(true).open(out).unwrap().write_all(&bytes).unwrap();
}
